title: backlog.py brief ID prints the worker's brief and dispatch ID starts the headless worker from it
goal: python3 _tools/backlog.py brief ID prints the brief the kb-sprint skill's run step 3 now composes by hand: the item's JSON and goal text, the role file path, the scratch directory, the in-flight sibling items with the files their touches change, the known failing tests the orchestrator names (--known TEST=BUG), the fixed worker rules (own checks, no tests.py --changed, the test ceiling, commit on work/<id> with KB-Work, never push, foreground tests, file bugs outside the item, gates for open choices) and the rules of the docs its touches map to (rag.py pack --root _self --item ID on the kb). python3 _tools/backlog.py dispatch ID makes the scratch directory _cache/scratch/<id>/, writes the brief there and starts claude -p --model sonnet --effort high --output-format json --add-dir <scratch> --max-turns <by kind: 60 task or subtask, 100 bug or untasked story, 200 research story or investigation bug> with the brief on stdin, never as a prompt argument (SP-d3hybrlv), records the session id and the pid on the item's claim, and with --dry-run prints the argv and the brief path without starting; --model names another model only when given. The kb-sprint skill's run step 3 shrinks to the two commands.
